claims.claim: Belgian winger who joined AC Milan in August 2026
claims.note: Statement dated 19 Aug 2026 announces the signing and calls him the Belgian winger.

claims.claim: AC Milan announced the signing from RC Strasbourg on 19 August; contract until 30 June 2031
claims.note: Statement says signed from RC Strasbourg, contract to 30 June 2031.

claims.claim: Wears number 22
claims.note: Statement lists squad number 22; Goal interview confirms.

claims.claim: beIN reported EUR 50m plus EUR 16m add-ons on a five-year contract
claims.note: beIN: reported 50m deal, 16m add-ons, five-year contract.

claims.claim: The club statement gives no fee
claims.note: Statement gives no transfer fee.

claims.claim: Plays mainly on the left flank, can play right, has played wing-back, full-back and attacking midfielder
claims.note: Milan feature says these things verbatim in substance.

claims.claim: Born in Liege on 6 August 2004
claims.note: Both give 6 Aug 2004 and Liege.

claims.claim: Full name Diego Manuel Jadon da Silva Moreira
claims.note: Milan feature gives the full name.

claims.claim: Father Almami was a Guinea-Bissau international and Standard Liege midfielder at his birth; grandfather Helmut Graf at Standard 1976-1982
claims.note: Milan feature states these facts.

claims.claim: Left home at 15 to pursue football
claims.note: Goal: 'When I was 15, I left home and my mum for football.'

claims.claim: Came through the academies of Standard Liege and Benfica
claims.note: Statement says so.

claims.claim: Joined Benfica in summer 2020 and signed a first professional contract
claims.note: Milan feature says so.

claims.claim: Helped Benfica U19 win the UEFA Youth League in 2021/22
claims.note: Statement says 2021/22.

claims.claim: Lifted the Under-20 Intercontinental Cup a few months later
claims.note: Statement: a few months afterwards.

claims.claim: Champions League debut in a qualifier against Midtjylland in August 2022
claims.note: Milan feature says so.

claims.claim: Chelsea signed him in summer 2023; first-team debut in August, Carabao Cup vs AFC Wimbledon
claims.note: Both confirm the summer 2023 signing and Carabao Cup debut.

claims.claim: Loan at Olympique Lyonnais in 2023/24: nine appearances in Ligue 1 and Coupe de France, returned January 2024
claims.note: Milan feature says so.

claims.claim: Moved permanently to RC Strasbourg in summer 2024
claims.note: Statement says so.

claims.claim: 76 appearances and seven goals at Strasbourg
claims.note: Both give 76 appearances and seven goals.

claims.claim: Assist totals differ: 15 (beIN) and 16 (AC Milan feature)
claims.note: Sources disagree; both cited, which matches the page.

claims.claim: Led Strasbourg in chances created (66)
claims.note: beIN: led Strasbourg in chances created (66).

claims.claim: Helped side come close to the Conference League final; dedicated player with a strong work ethic
claims.note: Milan feature says both things.

claims.claim: Played two Under-15 matches for Belgium before choosing Portugal
claims.note: DH article: two U15 youth matches.

claims.claim: Played for Portugal youth teams and at the 2023 U21 European Championship
claims.note: Statement says so.

claims.claim: In May 2025 the governing body approved the change of association from Portugal to Belgium
claims.note: DH article dated 20 May 2025 reports the approval; it attributes it to UEFA while the headline says FIFA, so the page says governing body.

claims.claim: First competitive senior appearances by September 2025, in World Cup 2026 qualifiers and friendlies
claims.note: Milan feature says so.

claims.claim: Only World Cup 2026 appearance: substitute in the round-of-32 win over Senegal
claims.note: beIN: one World Cup appearance, off the bench, round of 32 vs Senegal.

claims.claim: Shared a dressing room with Alexis Saelemaekers and Koni De Winter at the World Cup
claims.note: Milan feature says so.

claims.claim: Goal interview published 30 October 2026, first given to DAZN
claims.note: Goal: published Oct 30, 2026; originally given to DAZN.

claims.claim: Name chosen as his mother's favourite, 'also because of Diego Maradona'
claims.note: Goal: 'It was her favourite name, also because of Diego Maradona.'

claims.claim: Cristiano Ronaldo is his idol
claims.note: Goal: 'Cristiano Ronaldo is my idol.'

claims.claim: The derby is one of the most important matches in Europe
claims.note: Goal: 'The derby is one of the most important matches in Europe.'

claims.claim: Likes number 22; an honour to follow Kaka
claims.note: Goal: 'But I like 22.' and the honour sentence about Kaka.

claims.claim: Breakdance answer: 'I don't want to get injured'
claims.note: Goal: 'No, I don't want to get injured'.

valueNote: Puts the Milan transfer, the 2025 switch from Portugal to Belgium and the interview quotes in one dated, cited page, and flags the two conflicting assist totals.
summary: All checked claims match the opened sources; the assist totals are cited from both sources and the Maradona quote is worded as in the interview.
